title: Fewer Americans Move Each Year Than Ever Before
hook: Nobody's moving anymore. A cheap mortgage and a license requirement are both to blame.
closing: We didn't get more content. We got more stuck.
question: How long have you lived in one place?

segments.say: By 2023, fewer Americans moved each year than ever recorded.
Most homeowners are sitting on a mortgage under 4 percent, far cheaper than today's rate.
Today, roughly 25 percent of all US jobs require a government license to do.
